summary: Defines an SMTP extension and header field, Require-Recipient-Valid-Since, that lets senders say when they knew who owned a mailbox. Receivers can detect changes of ownership and avoid delivering sensitive mail to the wrong person.

eli5.summary: Before handing over a private letter, you check that the mailbox still belongs to the same person as when you last wrote.

questions: how to prevent email going to new mailbox owner
